bot_proxy.group: through the exits of the group «{group}»
bot_proxy.fallback: directly: the exits of the group «{group}» do not answer, the bot checks them every 5 minutes
bot_proxy.direct_no_keys: directly: the group «{group}» has no enabled keys
bot_proxy.none_group: no connection to Telegram (through the exits of the group «{group}» and directly)
bot_proxy.off: the bot is not set up
bot_proxy.log_fallback: The Telegram API proxy does not answer — the bot goes to Telegram directly for now
bot_proxy.log_back: The Telegram API proxy answers again — the bot goes through the exits
bot_proxy.cli_help: how the bot reaches Telegram: through the exits of a group, directly, or no connection
bot_proxy.bad_group: Choose a group of exits or «Directly».
bot_proxy.direct_pending: «Directly» is chosen — the bot switches within a minute
bot_proxy.direct_not_built: directly: the bot’s proxy of the keys of the group «{group}» is not built — the reason is in the SSH menu «Telegram API proxy»
